def locate(key,diff):
    module,mangled=key.rsplit('.x',1)
    function=mangled.rsplit('__mutmut_',1)[0]
    path=Path('src')/Path(*module.split('.')).with_suffix('.py')
    if str(path) not in trees:
        trees[str(path)]=ast.parse((ROOT/path).read_text())
        source_lines[str(path)]=(ROOT/path).read_text().splitlines()
    tree=trees[str(path)]
    if 'ǁ' in function:
        _,cls,function=function.split('ǁ')
        classes=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==cls]
        nodes=[n for clsnode in classes for n in clsnode.body]
    else:
        assert function.startswith('_'),(key,function)
        function=function[1:]; nodes=tree.body
    found=[n for n in nodes if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name==function]
    assert len(found)==1,(key,path,function)
    node=found[0]
    hunk=re.search(r'@@ -(\d+)',diff)
    line=min(node.end_lineno,node.lineno+int(hunk.group(1))-1) if hunk else node.lineno
    lines=source_lines[str(path)]
    return str(path),function,node.lineno,line,'\n'.join(lines[max(node.lineno-1,line-6):min(node.end_lineno,line+12)])
